title: Inject an OS file picker into a service
summary: A service asks for `filePicker` with `Needs`; platform calls stay in the adapter. `tac.nativeCapabilities` grants the capability separately from browser APIs. The macOS host uses NSOpenPanel and returns a selected file as an opaque activation-owned handle. `readText(handle)` reads at most 65,536 UTF-8 bytes and `release(handle)` ends access. Cancel, denied, unsupported, invalid and unavailable are typed results. A browser tab returns unsupported and opens no picker. Compiled native services request a typed FilePicker field through Needs or NeedsAll; the provider captures their activation and registered transport (ADR 0089). Other OS file pickers remain unsupported until an adapter is registered and qualified.
